# Living significance on the Becoming spine, characterized by a seed and boundary neutrality

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Evaluation is stated over one frame (the core process with realized claims), with no world model of its own. On a whole where formed relations connect living and further generation and some such claim exists, “every living claim is significant from every standpoint” (living significance at claim level) is equivalent to three conjuncts: some living claim is valued from some standpoint (a seed; any position holding self-significance with own living supplies one); significance passes along nonzero formed relations (relational neutrality); and significance of living content holds from every standpoint (standpoint neutrality). The positioned articulation D follows from the externalist articulation A. A sound inquiry whose goal is new living content gives every position with access a contributory reason for it. Seed, relational neutrality, standpoint neutrality, connection and A each have a consistent countermodel, and each normative rival is the same rule restricted by a formed boundary (own region, own standpoint, endorsers). The lifting rule L is transitive only through a live middle response.

Canonical source: [Metaethics.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Metaethics.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- S0, N_rel, N_std and A are explicit normative premises, not proved here; the result characterizes G0's content with no axiom; G0 was Ren's adopted axiom until Ren folded it on 11 October 2026, after which it is a condition in Part I (P51) and a theorem with the one axiom as a condition; on 16 October 2026 Ren folded Part II into the conditional section 6.15 of the chapter (section 6.4 since R36), and the theory does not assert the one axiom (P128). The direction from G0 to the premises is nearly immediate; the content lies in the converse and in minimality.
- A is an externalist articulation of contributory reasons: securing positive content from one's own standpoint on the response's scope, with access, supplies a contributory reason; endorsement is not a condition.
- Connection and soundness are conditions on the unfolding and the inquiry; the visible scope is defined by the policy's actual executions, not a free parameter.

`living` reads 生生; matching Ren's G0 uses the relational reading of renewing formation (relational-renewal-classification, relational-reading-comparison), a correspondence and not a Lean result of this module. `related` is a nonzero formed relation (conditioning, dependence, descent, cooperation) needing evidence in each application; a position's access can be a realized claim (AccessAt). The finite model's two standpoints and three lives serve minimality only. On the Becoming layer, the readings of `living` and `related` are taken from one run (becoming-renewal-reading, becoming-stepwise-reading), so connection and the application of universal_reason are relative to that run; a run-independent reading is not yet given.

Controls are not counted as new theorems; the same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts. Author's review only; no independent review yet. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run).

Proves none of S0, N, A, C, L or J, binds no position rejecting them, and does not treat the value of bringing new lives into existence. A contributory reason is not a duty or ranking and predicts no recognition or compliance. Sidgwick's dualism of practical reason is not dissolved; it is located at the boundary-neutrality premise.

- Present aim (no seed): both neutralities hold vacuously and nothing is significant. [Metaethics.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Metaethics.lean)
- Transmission inside the own region only: holds self-significance, a seed and standpoint neutrality and satisfies the transmission rule inside its own region, yet gives the connected other no significance. [Metaethics.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Metaethics.lean)
- Standpoint-relative: transmission holds within each standpoint, significance is shared only with itself, and the bystander's standpoint has none. [Metaethics.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Metaethics.lean)
- No connection: every normative premise holds and significance stops where formed relations stop; a zero-relation occurrence gains none automatically. [Metaethics.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Metaethics.lean)
- Internalism: with living significance fully holding, an articulation restricted to endorsers is consistent and withholds the reason from a non-endorsing position with access. [Metaethics.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Metaethics.lean)
